usage: 亮度 (brightness) is a noun used to describe the level of light emitted or reflected from a surface or screen.
You can use 亮度 to talk about adjusting the brightness on a device like a phone or computer screen.
亮度 can also describe the brightness of a light source or environment.
When using 亮度 in sentences, it often pairs with verbs like 調整 (to adjust) or 增加 (to increase).
亮度 is a measurable quality and usually takes quantitative descriptions like 高 (high) or 低 (low).
